_comment: The one price list. The booking forms offer exactly these labels, and the invoice function prices a booking by looking its label up here -- never by trusting a figure sent from the browser, since the anon key lets anyone insert any text. Labels are stored verbatim in reservations and sent to Make, so change a price by editing its label and figure together; a label that no longer matches is held for review rather than invoiced.
